Ahri.name: Ahri
Ahri.abilityDescription:
Passive: Start combat with fox-fires and gain more after casting, up to a limit. Then enter a flow state, moving faster and empowering subsequent casts.

Active: Launch all fox-fires at the target, each dealing magic damage. While in the flow state, launch a heart at the target that deals magic damage and split the fox-fires among enemies near the target.

Akali True Damage.name: Akali True Damage
Akali True Damage.abilityDescription:
B-Side Passive: After every set number of takedowns, gain Player Health.

Active: Rapidly slash through the current target, dealing magic damage, increased against Tanks. While casting, gain Durability and become untargetable by attacks. Then blink over the target and throw a bomb that deals magic damage split among nearby enemies.

Akali KDA.name: Akali KDA
Akali KDA.abilityDescription: Skateboard through the longest line of unpainted enemies, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and painting them and the hexes along the path. Painted enemies and enemies standing in painted hexes are Vulnerable, increasing damage taken. After every 3rd cast, ignite the paint to deal physical damage to all painted enemies and enemies standing in painted hexes.

Alistar.name: Alistar
Alistar.abilityName: Blue Cow Crying in the Rain
Alistar.abilityDescription: Heal, with the amount increased based on missing Health. Then slam the target, knocking up nearby enemies and dealing magic damage to all enemies hit.

Alune.name: Alune
Alune.abilityDescription:
Call down a spotlight on the target, dealing magic damage. Nearby enemies split magic damage. If the target dies, excess damage is split among the nearest enemies.

Heartsteel Upgrade: Fire blasts at the target that deal magic damage.

Amumu.name: Amumu
Amumu.abilityDescription: Heal and toss bandages at the nearest enemies, dealing magic damage and stunning them.

Annie.name: Annie
Annie.abilityDescription: Gain a shield, then unleash a cone of fire that deals magic damage to enemies and Burns and Wounds them for 4 seconds.

Aphelios.name: Aphelios
Aphelios.abilityDescription:
Passive: Gain a Chakram every set number of attacks, up to a maximum. Attacks deal bonus physical damage for each equipped Chakram. After reaching the maximum, gain bonus Attack Damage and infinite range.

Active: Fire bolts at the nearest enemies, dealing physical damage, then split into bolts that damage enemies they pass through. Gain Attack Speed for a duration.

Heartsteel Upgrade: Start combat with Chakrams equipped.

Ashe.name: Ashe
Ashe.abilityDescription: Her next attacks gain Attack Speed and become flurries of arrows. Each arrow deals physical damage.

Aurora.name: Aurora
Aurora.abilityDescription: Blink away and fire a blast through the best line, dealing magic damage to the two highest-Health enemies and less magic damage to the rest. Then blink back.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.abilityDescription:
Passive: Gain the Horn of the Traveler. While equipped, casts generate XP and attacks grant bonus Mana. 

Active: Summon a wave of meeps that deals magic damage to enemies hit, with damage reduced for each enemy it passes through.

Baron Nashor.name: Baron Nashor
Baron Nashor.abilityDescription: Summon an 8-member orchestra and a Riff Herald, knocking up all enemies. Deal physical and magic damage split among all enemies. Each minion attacks multiple times, dealing physical damage with each attack.

Braum.name: Braum
Braum.abilityDescription: Gain a shield, then slam the ground, dealing magic damage to adjacent enemies and stunning them.

Briar.name: Briar
Briar.abilityDescription: Heals and kicks a snack at the furthest enemy within range. Dashes toward it, dealing physical damage in an area. Then chow downs, gaining Attack Speed for the next several attacks and replacing them with slashes that deal physical damage.

Camille.name: Camille
Camille.abilityDescription:
Passive: When the target dies, hookshot to the next target and deal physical damage to them.

Active: Sweep-kick in a cone, dealing physical damage.

Dr Mundo.name: Dr Mundo
Dr Mundo.abilityDescription:
Passive: While Dr. Mundo has the required amount of max Health, he becomes Pumped Up, gaining max Health and causing attacks to deal bonus magic damage.

Active: Restore Health over time and deal magic damage each second to all nearby enemies.

Draven.name: Draven
Draven.abilityName: You Spin Me Round (Like An Axe)
Draven.abilityDescription: Throws a massive spinning record at the target, dealing physical damage. It leaves behind a vortex that deals physical damage per second, split among enemies within 1 hex.

Ekko.name: Ekko
Ekko.abilityDescription:
Passive: Rewinds a portion of damage taken over time.

Active: Instantly heals all damage being rewound and restores bonus Health, then deals magic damage to the current target.

Elise.name: Elise
Elise.abilityDescription: Transform into Spider Form, gaining Health. Fire webbing at the enemy that dealt the most damage this round, stunning the first enemy hit and dealing magic damage. Subsequent casts heal, then fire webbing.

Evelynn.name: Evelynn
Evelynn.abilityDescription:
Passive: At combat start, teleport behind the current target and become enshrouded for a duration. While enshrouded, become untargetable to attacks and gain Durability if enough other allies are alive.

Active: Deal magic damage to the current target and other enemies in a semi-circle, ignoring a portion of their Magic Resist.

Ezreal.name: Ezreal
Ezreal.abilityDescription:
Fire a missile that marks the target, then launch a second blast that detonates the mark, dealing physical damage to the target and units within 1 Hex.

Heartsteel Upgrade: The detonation deals increased damage. Every 3rd cast hits enemies within a 2 Hex radius instead.

Galio.name: Galio
Galio.abilityDescription: Gain a shield for a duration. Fire wind at the enemy who dealt the most damage this fight, dealing magic damage and stunning them for a duration.

Garen.name: Garen
Garen.abilityDescription: Heal, then fire a wave toward the current target, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and weakening them, reducing their damage dealt.

Gnar.name: Gnar
Gnar.abilityDescription: Passive: Every 3rd attack is replaced with a rock that deals physical damage and grants Gnar Attack Speed.

Gragas.name: Gragas
Gragas.abilityDescription: Become boisterous, restoring Health each second and dealing bonus magic damage on attack. For each 3-star K/DA ally, both effects increase.

Graves.name: Graves
Graves.abilityDescription: For the next attacks, gain Attack Speed, dash to targets, and fire a cone of bullets that each deal physical damage. On a kill, empower an additional attack.

Gwen.name: Gwen
Gwen.abilityDescription:
Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage to the target and other enemies in a cone. Dash to new targets. 

Active: After a short delay, summon a massive pair of scissors to snip a horizontal line on the target, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit, plus damage split between them. If only a limited number of enemies are hit, refund Mana.

Illaoi.name: Illaoi
Illaoi.abilityDescription:
Active: Heal and deal magic damage in a 2-hex line.

Quest: On cast during player combat, gain Fame, with bonus Fame for every 10g you have up to a gold cap. At the Fame threshold, go Platinum, gaining Durability and dropping gold on cast instead.

Janna.name: Janna
Janna.abilityDescription: Fire celestial dragons at nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. After several casts, envelop the arena in Heaven’s Gale, dealing magic damage to every enemy over time.

Jax.name: Jax
Jax.abilityDescription:
Bash the current target, dealing magic damage and healing for a percentage of damage dealt. Gain Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

EDM Upgrade: Fire beams at nearby enemies, dealing magic damage reduced for each enemy the beams pass through.

Jhin.name: Jhin
Jhin.abilityDescription: Passive: Convert bonus Attack Speed into Attack Damage. Attacks summon violins that strike in unison, dealing physical damage and captivating the target. Every fourth attack deals empowered physical damage and resets the violins. From the fourth sequence onward, all violins remain out, Jhin gains infinite range, and his attacks pierce targets, dealing reduced damage with each target hit.

Jinx.name: Jinx
Jinx.abilityDescription: Rapidly fire missiles at nearby enemies, each dealing physical damage.

KSante.name: KSante
KSante.abilityDescription:
Gain a shield, then charge and push the target, stunning them and other enemies hit before slamming them for physical damage. After charging, taunt nearby enemies.

Heartsteel Upgrade: Gain Armor and Magic Resist and deal bonus physical damage on attack.

Kaisa.name: Kaisa
Kaisa.abilityDescription:
Passive: Every few attacks, fire missiles that deal physical damage.

Active: Gain Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

Karthus.name: Karthus
Karthus.abilityDescription: After a brief delay, deal magic damage to the current target. If they die, recast this ability at reduced effectiveness.

Katarina.name: Katarina
Katarina.abilityDescription:
Twirl, slashing adjacent enemies for magic damage, then eviscerate the current target for magic damage.

Enemies hit are Captivated, and Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.

Kayle.name: Kayle
Kayle.abilityDescription:
Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage.

Active: Gain Attack Speed and infinite range for a duration, summoning a sword with each attack. Afterwards, rain swords on the target, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and additional magic damage to the target for each sword.

Kayn.name: Kayn
Kayn.abilityDescription:
Dash and swipe, dealing physical damage to enemies in a 2-hex line.

Heartsteel Upgrade: Transform into the Shadow Assassin at a health threshold, briefly becoming untargetable and dealing bonus magic damage for the rest of combat.

Kennen.name: Kennen
Kennen.abilityDescription: Passive: Reduce all incoming damage. Every second, zap adjacent enemies, dealing magic damage.

Kobuko.name: Kobuko
Kobuko.abilityDescription:
Passive: Your strongest Kobuko gains bonus Health based on Hyperpop Hype.

Active: Amp Up, healing each second for the duration.

Lee Sin.name: Lee Sin
Lee Sin.abilityName: Celestial Combo To Impress The Heavens
Lee Sin.abilityDescription: Unleash a combo attack beginning with Dragon Slam; subsequent casts add moves to the sequence. Dragon Slam deals physical damage to the target and reduced physical damage to nearby enemies. Tempest Spin deals physical damage to the target, knocks them up, and deals reduced physical damage to nearby enemies. Celestial Punch deals physical damage and marks the target; if they are already marked, it strikes their core for bonus true damage.

Leona.name: Leona
Leona.abilityDescription: Gain a shield for a duration. Call down beams of light on nearby enemies; each deals magic damage and reduces its target’s Magic Resist.

Lillia.name: Lillia
Lillia.abilityDescription: Heals and strikes the target, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and weakening them for a duration. Weakening reduces damage dealt.

Locke.name: Locke
Locke.abilityDescription:
Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage. All damage Locke deals to an enemy increases for each mark he has applied to them.

Active: Hurl 3 Soul Nails at the furthest enemy within range, dealing magic damage to and marking all enemies hit. Then teleport to that enemy and deal magic damage.

Lucian.name: Lucian
Lucian.abilityDescription: Dash to a nearby hex, then fire 2 shots at the target, each dealing physical damage.

Lulu.name: Lulu
Lulu.abilityDescription: Rotate between two effects: Whimsy! grants an ally decaying Attack Speed and deals magic damage on hit. Wild Growth increases an ally’s Health; while active, adjacent enemies take magic damage each second.

Lux.name: Lux
Lux.abilityDescription: Toss a prism into the air and blast it with a beam of light. The beam splits, dealing magic damage to the target and another nearby enemy. Gain Mana for each enemy killed.

Malzahar.name: Malzahar
Malzahar.abilityDescription: Fire a beam at the target, dealing magic damage over time. The energy rhythmically explodes 4 times, reducing the Magic Resist of enemies in an area and dealing magic damage with each explosion.

Mel.name: Mel
Mel.abilityDescription: Fire missiles split between the closest enemies, dealing magic damage and applying a stack of Blues to each. For every required stack threshold of Blues, enemies take increased damage from this ability.

Miss Fortune.name: Miss Fortune
Miss Fortune.abilityDescription: Fire a pinball toward the target, dealing physical damage. It bounces after hitting an enemy, damaging nearby enemies with reduced damage on each hit until it expires. Damage cannot fall below a minimum.

Mordekaiser.name: Mordekaiser
Mordekaiser.abilityDescription: Briefly gain Durability and summon a claw that deals magic damage in a massive line. The closest enemies take more damage and are pulled toward Mordekaiser. For the rest of combat, gain Omnivamp and Attack Range, and replace attacks with a slam that deals magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Nasus.name: Nasus
Nasus.abilityDescription:
Create a magnificent hex field that lasts several seconds. While active, heal each second, and allies within the field heal. Enemies take magic damage and are Captivated if they have less maximum Health than Nasus.

Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.

Neeko.name: Neeko
Neeko.abilityDescription: Convene the K/DA fan club and throw confetti streams at the target, each dealing magic damage. If a stream kills, permanently gain Ability Power.

Nidalee.name: Nidalee
Nidalee.abilityDescription: In Cougar Form, Pounce Party pounces on enemies, dealing magic damage that increases with each pounce. In Human Form, Dance of Life heals, then hurls a javelin at the target for magic damage and scatters flowers around them; after a brief delay, the flowers deal magic damage to enemies nearby.

Nunu.name: Nunu
Nunu.abilityDescription:
Passive: Gain Mana Regen. Slowly roll a Disco Ball, dealing magic damage to all enemies it passes through.

Active: For the rest of combat, move faster and increase the Disco Ball’s size and damage.

Olaf.name: Olaf
Olaf.abilityDescription: Passive: On attack, heal. On death, instead heal to full and gain Attack Speed, but lose a percentage of maximum Health each second.

Pyke.name: Pyke
Pyke.abilityName: Execute Gon' Give it to Ya
Pyke.abilityDescription:
Passive: When an enemy drops below the health threshold, instantly cast on them, then dash back to the current target.

Active: Deal physical damage to the target and to other enemies in an X shape. Execute enemies below the health threshold.

Qiyana.name: Qiyana
Qiyana.abilityDescription:
Passive: Qiyana’s ring changes color periodically, granting her ability different bonus effects.

Active: Dash through enemies in a line, dealing physical damage to the target and other enemies hit. Red deals bonus damage; Green heals based on damage dealt; Blue refunds mana; Gold grants gold and randomly applies one of the other effects.

Rakan.name: Rakan
Rakan.abilityDescription: Dash to a nearby group of enemies, then fling feathers split among enemies within 1 hex, dealing magic damage. Rakan hits enemies within 2 hexes and briefly knocks them up.

Rell.name: Rell
Rell.abilityDescription: While unmounted, Rhythm Blaster grants a shield and summons 3 speakers for a duration. Each second, they blast a wave that deals magic damage to enemies hit. While mounted, Metal Pony Club slams into a crowd, dealing magic damage to the center enemy and damage split among enemies within 2 hexes.

Renata Glasc.name: Renata Glasc
Renata Glasc.abilityDescription:
Fires a musical bar at the target, applying Toxin stacks that deal magic damage over time. Also applies Toxin to nearby enemies, prioritizing unpoisoned enemies. Enemies are Captivated when Toxin is applied; the effect lasts longer if their star level is less than or equal to Renata’s.

Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.

Renekton.name: Renekton
Renekton.abilityDescription: Grow larger, gaining max Health for the rest of combat. Then spin, dealing physical damage to adjacent enemies.

Samira.name: Samira
Samira.abilityDescription:
Passive: When Samira critically strikes an enemy, they become Captivated.

Active: Fire bullets at the current target, each dealing physical damage.

Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.

Senna.name: Senna
Senna.abilityDescription: Blast the target, dealing physical damage and marking them. If they’re already marked, detonate the mark instead, dealing damage. Detonating the mark or killing a marked enemy grants Damage Amp until the end of combat.

Seraphine.name: Seraphine
Seraphine.abilityDescription:
Indie: Release a stream of notes at the target while posing for the fans, dealing magic damage over 2.5 seconds.

Rising Star: Release bonus notes at nearby enemies.

Superstar: Toss high notes at every enemy.

Sett.name: Sett
Sett.abilityDescription:
Passive: Gain more maximum Health from all sources.

Active: Heal, then strike the target twice, dealing physical damage with each hit.

Heartsteel Upgrade: Periodically heal a portion of maximum Health, increased based on missing Health.

Shyvana.name: Shyvana
Shyvana.abilityDescription:
Passive: At a health threshold, transform into Dragon Form. While transformed, gain max Health and Attack Speed, and every third attack deals bonus magic damage in a 1-hex area.

Active: Gain a Shield for a duration.

Smeech.name: Smeech
Smeech.abilityDescription:
Passive: Gain Beats per attack and cast periodically.

Active: Gain a shield and deal physical damage to all enemies within 2 hexes, then strike the current target multiple times, dealing physical damage plus additional damage per Beat. After unleashing a set number of Beats, gain an emblem for a trait you don’t have active; the number of Beats required increases.

Sona.name: Sona
Sona.abilityDescription:
Passive: Cannot attack. Every few seconds, gains Mana, deals magic damage to nearby enemies, and grants allies a Shield for a duration.

Active: Sends a sonic wave across the battlefield, dealing magic damage split among all enemies and Stunning them for a duration. Allies gain a Shield split among them for a duration.

Swain.name: Swain
Swain.abilityDescription: Enter Demon Form, gaining max Health and dealing magic damage to adjacent enemies every second. Subsequent casts heal and increase the damage.

Syndra.name: Syndra
Syndra.abilityDescription: Spike a volleyball at the target, dealing magic damage. It bounces to the enemy behind them with the fewest items, dealing magic damage.

Taliyah.name: Taliyah
Taliyah.abilityDescription: Throws rocks at the target, each dealing magic damage. Every few casts, quickly repositions and surfs in a line, dealing magic damage based on enemies’ max Health and briefly knocking up enemies hit.

Taric.name: Taric
Taric.abilityDescription: Grant a shield to Taric and a nearby damaged ally for a duration.

Teemo.name: Teemo
Teemo.abilityDescription:
Passive: Attacks apply Viral, dealing magic damage over time. Infected enemies become zombies on death, seeking unaffected enemies and exploding to damage adjacent enemies and apply Viral.

Active: Launch a mushroom that applies Viral to enemies within 3 hexes and deals magic damage, reduced for each hex from the center.

Thresh.name: Thresh
Thresh.abilityDescription:
Passive: Periodically Captivate the farthest enemy who isn’t already Captivated.

Active: Heal, then drain max Health from nearby enemies over time. While draining, gain Durability.

Captivated enemies grant bonuses to Classical champions.

Tibbers.name: Tibbers
Tibbers.abilityDescription:
Passive: At low health or when your strongest Annie dies, become enraged, gaining max Health, Attack Damage, and Attack Speed that decays over time.

Active: Gain a shield for a fixed duration. If enraged, refresh the decaying Attack Speed.

Tristana.name: Tristana
Tristana.abilityDescription: Throw bombs at nearby enemies and detonate them, dealing physical damage. The final blast deals different physical damage.

Twisted Fate.name: Twisted Fate
Twisted Fate.abilityDescription:
Passive: At combat start, draw a card for each champion in the shop. If the shop has refreshed this round, gain loot based on the cards drawn: 1 or 2 of a kind grants gold, 3 of a kind grants a random champion, 4 of a kind grants an item component, and 5 of a kind grants a mystery box.

Active: The next 5 attacks gain Attack Speed and are replaced with cards that deal magic damage to the target and 2 nearby enemies.

Varus.name: Varus
Varus.abilityDescription: Fire a hail of arrows, dealing physical damage to the target and damage to adjacent enemies. Slow them, reducing their Attack Speed.

Vayne.name: Vayne
Vayne.abilityDescription:
Passive: On cast or when hit, tumble and gain Durability for a duration (cooldown applies).

Active: Gain demonic power, enhancing the next attacks to deal physical damage based on Attack Damage and the target’s max Health.

Vi.name: Vi
Vi.abilityDescription:
Summon giant hologram fists, gain a shield for a duration, and shield nearby allies. Slam the target repeatedly, dealing physical damage to them and damage to other enemies within 2 hexes.

EDM Upgrade: Slam one additional time and heal for a portion of the damage dealt by this ability.

Viego.name: Viego
Viego.abilityDescription: Summon swords around the target, then impale them after a brief delay, dealing physical damage per sword. Gain a permanent sword every set number of takedowns.

Vladimir.name: Vladimir
Vladimir.abilityDescription:
Passive: Gain Omnivamp. Debuffed enemies are Captivated.

Active: Deal magic damage to the nearest enemies and Captivate them for a duration. Every few casts, drop a chandelier that deals magic damage to all enemies, reduced for each hex they are from the epicenter.

Debuffs include Burn, Wound, Shred, Sunder, Mana Reave, Weaken, Slow, and Vulnerable.

Wukong.name: Wukong
Wukong.abilityName: The Tricks of the Many Mythical Tricksters
Wukong.abilityDescription: Heals Wukong and sends out clones in a 2-Hex circle that quickly return. Clones steal Armor and Magic Resist from enemies they pass through and deal physical damage. When they return, Wukong gains the stolen defenses.

Xayah.name: Xayah
Xayah.abilityName: Feathers Flying Like Leaves on the Wind
Xayah.abilityDescription: Summon feathers that strike the target, each dealing physical damage and reducing its Armor.

Yasuo.name: Yasuo
Yasuo.abilityDescription: Dash and thrust forward, dealing physical damage to enemies in a line. Every third cast, knock up the target and deal physical damage, then slam them down, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

Yone.name: Yone
Yone.abilityDescription:
Passive: This ability scales with whichever is higher, Attack Damage or Ability Power. Attacks deal physical damage.

Active: Rapidly strike the target and nearby enemies multiple times, dealing physical damage with each strike, then unleash a massive slash that deals physical damage to the target.

Heartsteel Upgrade: Strike additional times and ignore some of the target’s Armor.

Yorick.name: Yorick
Yorick.abilityDescription: Play an epic solo to restore Health and create a Hex zone that deals magic damage each second to enemies within. The final note deals magic damage to enemies in the zone and Slows them for a duration, reducing their Attack Speed.

Yunara.name: Yunara
Yunara.abilityDescription: For the rest of combat, attacks fire an additional orb that deals physical damage.

Yuumi.name: Yuumi
Yuumi.abilityName: Girl, Put Your Records On (Your Head)
Yuumi.abilityDescription: Throws a spinning disc that deals magic damage and stacks on the target, reducing their Magic Resist every second. When the stack reaches its required number of discs, it topples, dealing a portion of the stacked discs’ total damage to the target and splitting additional damage among nearby enemies. If an enemy dies with a disc, it passes to another enemy.

Zac.name: Zac
Zac.abilityDescription: Charge up, gaining Durability and healing. Then leap and crash onto the target, dealing magic damage to adjacent enemies and briefly knocking them up.

Zeri.name: Zeri
Zeri.abilityDescription: Quickly dashes around the arena, firing lasers in rapid succession at the current target. Each laser deals physical damage to enemies hit and ignores a portion of their Armor.

Ziggs.name: Ziggs
Ziggs.abilityDescription:
Passive: Attacks deal bonus magic damage.

Active: Throw a bomb at the target, dealing magic damage to them and adjacent enemies.

Zoe.name: Zoe
Zoe.abilityDescription: Fires a paddle ball backwards, then redirects it toward the farthest enemy, dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit. If that enemy dies, the ball ricochets to the next enemy hit and deals excess damage.
